decision: Qualify TQP-42 for the retained Windows implicit procedural hierarchy, sparse edit overlay, and 299,520-page large-world compaction profile.
alternatives_considered: materialize all 299,520 declared page keys in the runtime hot path
mandate an explicit pointer octree without comparative evidence
retain journal-only restart and leave large-world compaction unsupported
treat the previous all-pages snapshot rejection as acceptable positive evidence
claim a general production save format from one retained procedural profile
evidence: native exact hierarchy contract for page presence, ancestor, complete children, same-LOD neighbors, ranges, and viewer roots against a retained flat sorted catalog
seven-run native benchmark pinned to upstream commit ecf9e33 with p50, p95, p99, worst, executable hash, peak working set, and deterministic authority hash
299,520 declared pages represented by a 40-byte implicit hierarchy descriptor and zero explicit runtime catalog entries
central construction and finite-boundary carve compacted into 32 sparse overlay pages in the Godot reference workload
fresh-runtime reopen reproducing authoritative samples, state signature, and regenerated geometry signature
current-schema migration plus fail-closed corrupt descriptor, missing manifest, interrupted publication, duplicate/malformed hierarchy, and capacity controls
@tool Sparse Hierarchy Observatory source and compact/reopen workflows with live hierarchy, overlay, cache, residency, queue, and query counters
complete upstream M5 and production qualification suites on Godot 4.6.3 and 4.7, plus matching debug and release snapshot-query hashes
qualified_scope: Windows debug implicit procedural hierarchy for the retained 128x16x128-chunk, 299,520-page reference
exact hierarchy queries and runtime demand without materializing every declared page key
localized durable central and finite-boundary edits with sparse overlay compaction
large-world compact, reopen, replay, adaptive resource regeneration, and current-schema migration
separate declared hierarchy, sparse index, overlay index, cache, active record, render, and collision counters
bounded fail-closed descriptor, manifest, publication, hierarchy, and sparse-overlay capacity controls
unqualified_scope: planet-scale, unbounded, distributed, networked, or GPU-resident worlds
production save compatibility or an immutable public file format
arbitrary explicit sparse catalogs that violate complete refinement ancestry
multi-hour soak, disk exhaustion, allocation failure, concurrent process writers, or randomized schedule fault injection
non-Windows performance, production frame pacing, low-power targets, Gate E, or production terrain
standards_changed: TQP-F002 closed for the retained sparse procedural snapshot profile
review: Qualification fails closed if the upstream commit, executable or contract hash, exact hierarchy comparisons, retained counts and signatures, compact/reopen replay, migration, resource regeneration, negative controls, observatory workflow, provenance, or explicit limitations differ.
downstream_impact: TQP-43 becomes the next dependency-ordered milestone. TQP-F002 no longer blocks the retained 2K procedural profile, but generic production save compatibility and Gate E remain unqualified.
